verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's marketing pages describe built-in agentic workflows: a Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent and a Transaction Monitoring agent that auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk cases to humans. This is genuine in-product delegation of alert-review work to AI, but it covers fixed workflows rather than a general assistant users can hand arbitrary tasks to, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized. Missing for 10: an interactive or conversational assistant for ad-hoc task delegation, first-party technical docs on agent behavior and controls, user-configurable delegation scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
